limitations.message:
Not supported: RGB SysEx uses paired MSB/LSB per 8-bit RGB component and pad ranges. Introduction reply claims four data bytes but lists nine faders; literal 00x4F/00x7F typos retained. Needs dedicated parser, initialization reply excluded.
Not included: Custom RGB SysEx, inquiry and introduction transactions

Based on archived manufacturer documentation. The complete extraction metadata, original excluded chart rows and source files are retained in the manufacturer evidence archive. No hardware testing is claimed.
